name: sidebar-shared
title: Sidebar parts
description: The pieces the sixteen sidebar blocks share: brand header, search box, team switcher, account menu, project and secondary lists, folding calendars, a page header with breadcrumbs, and the small hand-written note that stands where content goes. It installs by itself with any sidebar block; copy the parts you like into your app.
docs:
Installed the "Sidebar parts" block into your components directory under blocks/sidebar-shared/.
Its files are under "<your components alias>/blocks/sidebar-shared".
